title: Newspaper
subtitle: 「報紙／日報／新聞刊物／大報／小報」，究竟是哪一種 newspaper？
description: 「報紙／日報／新聞刊物／大報／小報」，究竟是哪一種 newspaper？

words.note: 使用者提供的核心近義詞。非常自然、口語，尤其 British English 常用 the paper 指報紙；也可指某一間報館／報章。
words.example: I read about the story in the paper this morning.

exercises.original: I saw the report in the newspaper on the train this morning.
exercises.zh: 我今早在火車上從報紙看到那篇報道。
exercises.upgrade: paper · 報紙；報章

options.explanation: 日常閱讀語境、沒有正式分類需要，the paper 是最自然的口語改寫。
名詞時指每日出版的報紙，核心是出版頻率。 本句只是日常閱讀／購買／頭版語境，沒有出版頻率、報紙類型或正式機構分類線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 paper 精確。
正式分類詞，泛指以新聞內容為主的出版物，範圍可比 newspaper 稍廣。 本句只是日常閱讀／購買／頭版語境，沒有出版頻率、報紙類型或正式機構分類線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 paper 精確。

新聞機構／渠道的上位概念，可包括報紙、網站、電視、電台。 本句只是日常閱讀／購買／頭版語境，沒有出版頻率、報紙類型或正式機構分類線索。 因此在這一句裡不如 paper 精確。

exercises.original: The newspaper is published every morning and has editions in several cities.
exercises.zh: 這份報紙每天早上出版，並在多個城市發行不同版本。
exercises.upgrade: daily · 日報；每日出版的報紙

options.explanation: published every morning 明確指出每日出版頻率，因此 daily 最精確。
日常口語中常直接指報紙，但本身也有其他詞義。 本句明確有 every morning、seven days a week、issued every day 等頻率線索，因此要突出每日出版。 因此在這一句裡不如 daily 精確。
較窄，通常指嚴肅型／傳統大版面報紙。 本句明確有 every morning、seven days a week、issued every day 等頻率線索，因此要突出每日出版。 因此在這一句裡不如 daily 精確。

exercises.original: The library collects newspapers and other printed sources as part of its archive of news media.

falseSynonyms.zh: paper 是最自然的口語近義詞之一，但也可指紙張、論文等；需由上下文判斷。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I read it in the paper. This paper is made from recycled fibres.

falseSynonyms.zh: daily 只適合每天出版的報紙；週報不能叫 daily。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She writes for a national daily. The village newspaper appears once a week.

falseSynonyms.zh: news publication 是較正式、較廣的分類，可包括數碼新聞刊物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The archive contains many news publications. I bought a newspaper at the station.

falseSynonyms.zh: broadsheet 是報紙的一種格式／風格，通常較嚴肅；不是所有 newspapers 都是 broadsheets。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The broadsheet published a long investigation. The local newspaper prints community notices.

falseSynonyms.zh: tabloid 是特定報紙類型，常見聳動標題、名人內容或較緊湊版式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The tabloids covered the celebrity scandal. The newspaper specialises in financial news.

falseSynonyms.zh: news outlet 指新聞機構或渠道，可包括 TV、radio、website；範圍比 newspaper 大。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Several news outlets reported the result. The newspaper arrived before breakfast.

falseSynonyms.zh: newsletter 通常是機構／社群向特定讀者發送的定期消息，不等於公開發行的 newspaper。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The club emails a monthly newsletter. The city has two daily newspapers.

falseSynonyms.zh: article 是報紙中的一篇文章，不是整份報紙。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I read an article in the newspaper. The newspaper contains dozens of articles.
